about.title: About
about.disclaimer: The Shining Prow application and its affiliates follow different agreements; the main program and its affiliates are not affiliated with Skull and Bones or the Ubisoft Group.

manifesto.title: Shining Prow was born here ——————
manifesto.p1: In the endless ocean of games, every player is an adventurer sailing alone. Ahead is the unknown mist, behind is the track of exploration.
manifesto.p2: Shining Prow is not just a decoration on the bow, but the light that pierces through the mist. When you are lost, it is the lighthouse that illuminates the path ahead; when you are confused, it is the wisdom that deciphers the puzzles.
manifesto.p3: We believe that every game is a world waiting to be explored, and every player deserves the clearest guidance. Shining Prow gathers community wisdom, refines practical tools, and turns them into eternal starlight to accompany your every voyage. From the initial glimmer to today's beacon, we have always held a single belief: serving the voyagers and guiding the explorers.
manifesto.p4: Join us and let your gaming journey no longer be lonely. Shining Prow, always shining ahead.

about.thanks: At the same time, thanks to the <u>@SkullAndBonesTools/SkullAndBonesData</u> project for providing the original data sources, which made the development of Shining Prow possible.
about.openSourceContribution: Contributing to Open Source 🎉, loving what we do.

5.name: Apprentice Pirate
5.desc: Serving up rum and still learning port from starboard. Not much silver, but every grand voyage begins here.

10.name: Twins
10.desc: The inseparable pair on the masthead lookout: one watching the wind, the other eyeing yer purse.

50.name: Boatswain
50.desc: Sails, guns, rigging — and the back of every seasick newcomer's head. Without the bosun, the ship wobbles before she leaves harbour.

100.name: Corsair
100.desc: A proper privateer with papers in hand, roaming the trade winds. Plunder by the book, spend it with pride.

500.name: Quartermaster
500.desc: Second only to the captain — keeper of the loot shares and shipboard discipline. One slap of the cutlass on the table ends every argument on deck.

1000.name: Captain
1000.desc: The legend in a gilded tricorne with a whole fleet at their back. Yer name goes atop the highest stern gallery, and every sea lane flies signals at yer command.

custom.name: Custom Bounty
custom.desc: Toss however many coins ye like into the chest — meet the mark, and earn a title all the same.
